    As of April 2026, Lamar Odom, 46, is focusing on sobriety and mental health advocacy following his 2015 near-fatal overdose, recently appearing in the Netflix documentary Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom. He is heavily involved in addiction recovery, reportedly owning multiple "Odom Wellness Treatment Centers" in California. 
    Current Life and Endeavors 
    • Sobriety & Health: Odom has remained sober and is active in recovery, opening up about his past trauma and health struggles.
    • Business: He has transitioned into the wellness industry, investing in and operating drug rehabilitation centers, often named Odom Wellness Treatment Centers.
    • Documentary: He starred in a 2026 Untold Netflix episode, revisiting his NBA career with the Lakers, his 2015 brothel overdose, and his marriage to Khloé Kardashian.
    • Relationships: He is currently single and, according to recent updates, focusing on his children. 
    Past Events and Recovery 
    • Overdose Recovery: Following his 2015 incident, Odom suffered 12 strokes and six heart attacks but made a significant recovery.
    • Finances: Due to medical expenses, he sold his championship rings, which were later offered back to him. 
    Odom is now focused on rebuilding his life and helping others with addiction.
